newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen opening lower, techs set to slump.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen opening lower, techs set to slump.

text.p: Wall Street is expected to open lower on Friday, hurt by a slump in technology stocks, after software giant Microsoft reported fourth-quarter results which were seen as somewhat disappointing, analysts said.
Weakness in the technology sector, whose recent power has helped the broader equities market rise, would likely drag both the Nasdaq composite and the Dow industrials down, analysts said.
Both indices also closed lower on Thursday.
